field_rules_lua.value:
-- Flash multiball. See ../MULTIBALL_TECHNICAL.md for the whole design.
--
-- Two things live here. The virtual outhole, which is what makes a second ball
-- possible at all, and the multiball itself. The ROM is never told that either
-- exists.

local SW_THREE_BANK_SERIES = 31   -- closes when the whole three-bank is down
local SW_FIVE_BANK_SERIES = 37    -- closes when the whole five-bank is down
local SW_EJECT_HOLE = 27
local SW_TROUGH_REST = 210        -- where a ball comes to rest
local SW_TROUGH_SECOND = 211      -- the position behind it
local SW_PLAYFIELD_TILT = 47
local SW_OUTHOLE_TO_ROM = 48      -- virtual: no board has this switch

local COIL_BALL_RELEASE = 1
local COIL_EJECT_HOLE = 5

local SCENE_MULTIBALL = 60011
local EFFECT_READY = "multiball-ready"    -- endless rainbow while it waits
local EFFECT_START = "multiball-start"    -- one second of strobe, and the rainbow is gone
local EFFECT_LOST = "multiball-lost"      -- a moment of nothing, same job

-- A ball entering an empty trough touches the second switch on its way to the
-- resting one. Both may read closed for an instant if the spacing allows it,
-- and reporting the outhole then would end a multiball that is still running.
-- So closing is confirmed, and opening is not: a ball leaving the trough is
-- never ambiguous.
local OUTHOLE_CONFIRM_MS = 150

local PHASE_IDLE = 0
local PHASE_READY = 1
local PHASE_WAIT_PLUNGE = 2
local PHASE_RUNNING = 3

local phase = PHASE_IDLE
local threeBankDown = false
local fiveBankDown = false
local troughRest = false
local troughSecond = false
local reportedOuthole = nil
local confirmToken = 0

local function reportOuthole(state)
  if reportedOuthole ~= state then
    reportedOuthole = state
    ppuc.sendSwitchToCpu(SW_OUTHOLE_TO_ROM, state)
  end
end

local function troughChanged()
  -- Bumping the token cancels any confirmation still in flight, so a ball that
  -- rolls through does not report an outhole a moment after it has left.
  confirmToken = confirmToken + 1
  if troughRest and troughSecond then
    local token = confirmToken
    ppuc.after(OUTHOLE_CONFIRM_MS, function()
      if token == confirmToken and troughRest and troughSecond then
        reportOuthole(1)
      end
    end)
  else
    reportOuthole(0)
  end
end

local function armIfBothBanksDown()
  if phase == PHASE_IDLE and threeBankDown and fiveBankDown then
    phase = PHASE_READY
    ppuc.effectTrigger(EFFECT_READY, 1)
    ppuc.speech("Multiball ready")
  end
end

-- Flash numbers its cabinet switches 1 to 8 -- tilts, coin, credit, high score
-- -- and its playfield from 9 up. The button flag catches the flipper buttons
-- wherever they are numbered, and the playfield tilt is on the playfield but is
-- not a player putting a ball into play.
local function isPlayfieldHit(number)
  return number >= 9 and number < 200 and number ~= SW_PLAYFIELD_TILT and not ppuc.isButtonSwitch(number)
end

local function startMultiball()
  phase = PHASE_WAIT_PLUNGE
  -- The ball the player just shot stays in the eject hole. Its neighbour goes
  -- to the shooter lane instead, which is the whole trick.
  ppuc.pulseCoil(COIL_BALL_RELEASE, 120)
  ppuc.serumScene(SCENE_MULTIBALL)
  ppuc.speech("Multiball")
  -- Not a "stop": the firmware has no such thing. A higher-priority effect
  -- terminates the endless one, so the thing that ends the waiting rainbow is
  -- the flourish that announces the multiball. See MULTIBALL_TECHNICAL.md.
  ppuc.effectTrigger(EFFECT_START, 1)
  -- One ball waits in the shooter lane and one in the eject hole. Nothing is
  -- lost and a search would fire coils under both of them.
  ppuc.holdBallSearch(true)
end

local function secondBallIsInPlay()
  phase = PHASE_RUNNING
  ppuc.holdBallSearch(false)
  ppuc.pulseCoil(COIL_EJECT_HOLE, 120)
end

function ppuc.onCoilChanged(number, state)
  if number ~= COIL_EJECT_HOLE or state ~= 1 then
    return
  end

  if phase == PHASE_READY then
    -- The ROM fires the eject hole the instant the ball lands in it. Not this
    -- time.
    ppuc.suppressCoil(COIL_EJECT_HOLE)
    startMultiball()
  elseif phase == PHASE_WAIT_PLUNGE then
    -- The ball is still sitting there, so the ROM keeps asking. It stays ours
    -- until the player puts the second ball into play.
    ppuc.suppressCoil(COIL_EJECT_HOLE)
  end
end

function ppuc.onSwitchChanged(number, state)
  if number == SW_TROUGH_REST then
    troughRest = state == 1
    troughChanged()
  elseif number == SW_TROUGH_SECOND then
    troughSecond = state == 1
    troughChanged()
  end

  if state ~= 1 then
    return
  end

  if not ppuc.attractMode() then
    if number == SW_THREE_BANK_SERIES then
      threeBankDown = true
      armIfBothBanksDown()
    elseif number == SW_FIVE_BANK_SERIES then
      fiveBankDown = true
      armIfBothBanksDown()
    end
  end

  if phase == PHASE_WAIT_PLUNGE then
    -- Either the player plunged and hit something, or they plunged into a
    -- drain. Both mean the second ball is no longer waiting.
    if isPlayfieldHit(number) or number == SW_TROUGH_REST or number == SW_TROUGH_SECOND then
      secondBallIsInPlay()
    end
  end
end

function ppuc.onBallChanged(ball)
  -- The opportunity lasts one ball. Both banks have to go down again on the
  -- next one, which is what the player is told.
  threeBankDown = false
  fiveBankDown = false

  if phase == PHASE_READY then
    -- Drained without shooting the eject hole. The rainbow has to go, and
    -- nothing else should be announced, so this one shows nothing.
    ppuc.effectTrigger(EFFECT_LOST, 1)
  end
  if phase ~= PHASE_IDLE then
    ppuc.holdBallSearch(false)
  end
  phase = PHASE_IDLE
end
